state.goal: Improve open local Jeff fact-checking and decision API; all actual training on Colab. Choose bounded work, not a new architecture by assertion. This digest is an incomplete human/agent summary, not the original full corpus.

measured.calibration_caveat: Jev Brier is lower than Jeff; lower ECE does not establish overall probability superiority. This evaluation set has already informed error analysis and threshold searches, so is no longer independent confirmatory evidence.
measured.failure_shape: Jeff improves supported recall relative to Jev but is worse on NEI, predominantly single-passage rows. Tiny probes fail missing conjuncts and overstated quantities.
measured.implemented: served model is Qwen3-4B+LoRA; arbitrary label schema at call time; non-generated typed output; Score uses full-label sequence likelihood when first tokens collide. Separate OptionScorer already encodes state once and attends semantic option queries, but is not serving.

past_arms.decision_rules: Bias/threshold/TTA historically weak. Human-upweight test was 1.5B, not same 4B model.
past_arms.native_encoder: Qwen OptionScorer got no valid held-out score: val_files ignored, configured optim nesting ignored, mean loss divided by batch again. NaN was empty-validation sentinel. Thus not a clean failure of architecture.
past_arms.soft_distill: Not yet trained successfully. Existing teacher targets available. Proposed unchanged 12119 row recipe, 4x8 microbatch, CE + KL(q||p), eligible Choice/Noul 10319 rows; Score excluded by token collision. Hybrid optimum generally differs from q, unlike KL alone. Padding bug being fixed.
past_arms.resume: Checkpoint optimizer parameter ordering/config/RNG and atomic snapshot invariants not fully tested. A fresh uninterrupted run avoids resume dependency but does not retroactively prove historic baseline identical.

landscape.Simple_Jev_RFDT: Current upstream trains selected candidate soft CE directly, with padded-candidate mask and disjoint context/source groups. Shared-prefix caches in inference; no separate learned classification head.
landscape.evidence_sufficiency: Atanasova et al TACL 2022 evidence omission augmentation; later construction-aware work warns placeholder/no-evidence NEI does not transfer to topically related insufficient evidence.
landscape.calibration: Guo et al temperature scaling is posthoc; must fit on independent carve. Existing baseline already trained on our carve, so no clean calibration comparison with it.

next.instructions: Which next action has best expected fact-checking improvement per bounded GPU cost, given uncertainty? Choose one; do not treat your judgment as empirical evidence.

criteria.hybrid_existing: Fix candidate mask, validate disjointness, fresh full 2-epoch preregistered CE+KL run; historical control with explicit provenance caveats.
criteria.pure_decision: New matched hard-vs-soft restricted-candidate CE runs; direct distillation objective, additional control compute.
criteria.targeted_data: Create train-only topic-matched evidence-omission/partial-support examples with independent label checking, then matched retrain.
criteria.native_encoder: Repair OptionScorer training/config/validation before a shared-state architecture pilot.

replication.instructions: What does existing evidence establish about the separate shared-state OptionScorer?

criteria.unresolved: Implementation exists but quality experiment invalid; potential speed/quality remains unresolved.
criteria.failed: Architecture shown unable to perform task.

hybrid.instructions: Does adding KL(q||p) to hard-target CE guarantee the TOTAL loss has its optimum at the teacher distribution q for non-one-hot q?

independence.instructions: Can this already repeatedly inspected scale set honestly serve as a fully untouched confirmatory holdout for new designs informed by its errors?

release.instructions: Does matching output shapes plus tiny capability probes establish complete semantic capability parity with hosted Jev?

interpretation: Judge over disclosed digest only. Not proof of optimal experiment or performance.
